# PI objectives — tranche 5

## Objectives

- O1 — T7's record is complete and its manifest green, closed by a distinct approver.
- O2 — The operations gate executes: triage with no write, approved mitigation read-back, resolve
  with a postmortem, and a destructive call without approval refused.
- O3 — restart, scale, rollback and flag-flip are callable and read back; an undeclared verb is
  refused; a dry run makes no write.
- O4 — The cluster live proof runs once the deployed operator CLI exists; deploy-bound.
- O5 — Tranche 5's other projects are assessed against their manifests; the tranche review
  decides on the evidence.

## Business value

O1 10, O2 9, O3 8, O4 7, O5 6 (committed: O1–O3).

## Measurement

O1 by `acceptance/programme/T7.toml`; O2 and O3 by the executed suite (`/tmp/u5a-r9/evidence/T7-acceptance.md`); O4 by the live
proof when its prerequisites exist; O5 by the tranche review.

## Evidence

The PI plan's ids and paths (`01a1d039-0d34-7f89-a0be-f3de3c9f540e`, `01a1e9e0-fe45-77e0-993a-d571fecc5ec1`, the journal) and the acceptance transcript.
